_comment: GH#338 -- THE quest-hints canonical, and the only script that pins the hint array (spec pin policy). Loads door_awakening_start via title Continue: every earlier beat of The Door That Goes Elsewhere is closed and door_awakened is not banked, so the active beat is `attune`, the ONE code-banked beat in the game -- no map produces its counter, so its own copy is the only pointer a player ever gets, which is exactly the shape the friend's report named. Proves: the payload's new `quest_line_texts`/`quest_hint_lines` keys (the count-only gap closed), the indented sub-row rendering DEFAULT ON, the 'Quest Hints' settings row switching it off with the quest line itself byte-unchanged, and switching it back on. Fixture rng_state governs; seed 9 held for convention.

steps._comment: Continue loads door_awakening_start: every earlier beat of The Door That Goes Elsewhere is banked and door_awakened is not, so the ACTIVE beat is `attune` -- the one code-banked beat in the game and the exact beat the friend's report was about.

DEFAULT ON. `quest_line_texts` closes the count-only gap (the payload used to carry a bare `quest_lines: 1`); `quest_hint_lines` is parallel to it by index and carries the indented sub-row the panel drew underneath. Pinned VERBATIM -- this is the one canonical that pins the hint array, per the spec's pin policy.

quest_hint_lines: Take a bed at the inn and sleep. The Door goes on working at the stone while you rest.

steps._comment: THE OFF SWITCH. Pause -> Settings (row 8) -> a fresh open puts the cursor on 'Master volume' (index 0); down x14 reaches 'Quest Hints' (index 14, appended immediately before 'Back'). Confirm turns it off.

steps._comment: down x1 -> 'Back' (index 15), confirm closes settings and the pause menu resumes; cancel closes the pause menu.

HINTS OFF: the quest line is byte-identical and the sub-row is gone. Scope proof, too -- the toggle blanks the journal sub-row and nothing else; `quest_lines` and `quest_line_texts` do not move, and the Leads strip / 'Quest updated:' toast were never in scope (ruling 3).
